Final citation counts are separate from original-text working memory; retained_spans may select key ranges in delivered text for later rereading or adjustment. Use ready once the requirement can be delivered; incomplete with evidence for a remaining gap after partial results, or unavailable when no evidence was obtained; both require a specific gap. General scope notes do not reduce status, and unrequested certification or exhaustiveness is not required. The plan is working data, not a final citation list.
